BEGIN
 if :ctrl_block.from_donation_date is not null and :ctrl_block.to_donation_date is not null then
 go_block('donations');
 :system.message_level := 10;
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 end if;
 
 SELECT count(*)into :ctrl_block.found from donations
 where unit_id is not null
 and donation_type in('AL')
 AND coll_date between :ctrl_block.from_donation_date and :ctrl_block.to_donation_date
 and not exists (select donor_id from donor_id_print_det dip WHERE COLL_DATE BETWEEN

Block.Name: DONATIONS
Block.WhereClause:
coll_date between :ctrl_block.from_donation_date and :ctrl_block.to_donation_date
and unit_id is not null
and donation_type = 'AL'
and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
and not exists (select donor_id from donor_id_print_det dip WHERE COLL_DATE BETWEEN
:CTRL_BLOCK.FROM_DONATION_DATE AND :CTRL_BLOCK.TO_DONATION_DATE and
dip.donor_id=donations.donor_id)

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin

 select initcap(last_name||','||' '|| first_name) name
 into :donations.name
 from donors
 where donors.donor_id =:donations.donor_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end;
 begin
 select substr(ltrim(absorbance,'0'),1,4) into :donations.lab
 from UTRS WHERE
 unit_id =:donations.unit_id and 
 coll_date = :DONATIONS.coll_date
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and test_id ='CHOL';
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;



 begin
 select substr(ltrim(absorbance,'0'),1,4) into :donations.donor
 from unit_test_results 
 where Unit_id =:donations.unit_id
 and coll_date = :donations.coll_date
 and CHAPTER_ID = :global.chapter_id --'WAD' 
 and test_id ='CHOL';
 
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;

 end;


 declare
 szChkDgt varchar2(3);
 begin 
 if length(:donations.unit_id)=13 then 
 VALIDATE_UNIT_CHKDIGIT(:donations.unit_id,szChkDgt);
 :donations.dummy_unit_id:=:donations.unit_id||ltrim(szChkDgt);
 else
 :donations.dummy_unit_id:=:donations.unit_id;
 end if; 
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
